title: The Majestic Angkor Wat
description: Step back in time and explore the world's largest religious monument, a masterpiece of Khmer architecture.
summary: Angkor Wat offers breathtaking temple architecture, cultural storytelling, and unforgettable sunrise views.
bestTime: Early morning for the best light and calm atmosphere

title: Tropical Paradise Koh Rong
description: Relax on pristine white sands and swim in crystal-clear turquoise waters at Cambodia's premier island destination.
summary: Koh Rong offers white-sand beaches, clear water, and peaceful island nightlife for an easy escape.
bestTime: November to February for calm seas and warm weather
entryFee: Boat transfer and island fee apply

title: Eco-Adventure in Cardamom
description: Immerse yourself in one of Southeast Asia's last great rainforests and discover rare wildlife and hidden waterfalls.
summary: Cardamom offers jungle trails, wildlife sightings, and a refreshing break from busy city life.
bestTime: Rainy season brings lush scenery and full waterfalls
